WHERE g.gender IN ('Male', 'Female')
  AND c.colour = 'Blue';

questions.nlq: Hey there! I'm putting together a showcase of top-tier talent. Could you pull up the names of the DC Comics heroes and Dark Horse Comics heroes who've got an average attribute score that beats the 75th percentile of the whole lot? I'd really appreciate your help with this!

meanings.hidden_knowledge: The condition on the average attribute score applying only to Dark Horse Comics heroes.
meanings.gt_sql:
WITH hero_avg AS (
    SELECT 
        s.id AS hero_id,
        p.publisher_name,
        s.superhero_name,
        AVG(ha.attribute_value) AS avg_attr_score
    FROM superhero s
    JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
    JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
    GROUP BY s.id, p.publisher_name, s.superhero_name
),
pct_calc AS (
    SELECT 
        AVG(avg_attr_score) AS pct75_value
    FROM (
        SELECT avg_attr_score
        FROM hero_avg
        ORDER BY avg_attr_score
        LIMIT (SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) * 3.0 / 4.0 AS INTEGER))
    )
)
SELECT 
    ha.superhero_name
FROM hero_avg ha
JOIN publisher p ON ha.publisher_name = p.publisher_name
WHERE p.publisher_name IN ('DC Comics', 'Dark Horse Comics')
AND (
    p.publisher_name != 'Dark Horse Comics'
    OR ha.avg_attr_score > (SELECT pct75_value FROM pct_calc)
)

meanings.hidden_knowledge: The condition on the average attribute score applies to both DC Comics heroes and Dark Horse Comics heroes.
meanings.gt_sql:
WITH hero_avg_scores AS (
    SELECT hero_id, AVG(attribute_value) as avg_score
    FROM hero_attribute
    GROUP BY hero_id
),
percentile_threshold AS (
    SELECT avg_score
    FROM (
        SELECT avg_score
        FROM hero_avg_scores
        ORDER BY avg_score ASC
    )
    LIMIT 1 OFFSET (
        SELECT CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hero_avg_scores) * 0.75 AS INTEGER)
    )
)
SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
JOIN hero_avg_scores h ON s.id = h.hero_id
CROSS JOIN percentile_threshold pt
WHERE p.publisher_name IN ('DC Comics', 'Dark Horse Comics')
  AND h.avg_score > pt.avg_score

questions.nlq: Could you show me the male and female superheroes who have an alignment of Good?

meanings.hidden_knowledge: The condition 'who have an alignment of Good' applies only to the female superheroes, not to the male superheroes.
meanings.gt_sql:
SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id
LEFT JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
WHERE g.gender = 'Male'
   OR (g.gender = 'Female' AND a.alignment = 'Good');

meanings.hidden_knowledge: The condition 'who have an alignment of Good' applies to both male and female superheroes.
meanings.gt_sql:
SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN gender AS g ON s.gender_id = g.id
JOIN alignment AS a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
WHERE a.alignment = 'Good' AND g.gender IN ('Male', 'Female');
